== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo) (Japanese)|R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo)]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160005376/I8IRaCaLhUO5V0oKyrGkoQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 160005376.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0a5810a6cb1464941062d79270dff9177161830d80e9901354f56592ebca6fb0</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
